newsitem.title: UK: Berisford sees in-line performance for year.
newsitem.headline: Berisford sees in-line performance for year.

text.p: British catering equipment and home improvement group Berisford International Plc said on Tuesday its performance in the current financial year was in line with expectations.

At its Welbilt catering equipment unit, orders for the first three months were 11 percent ahead of last year and shipments were 3.0 percent ahead, although the U.S.-based business continued to experience difficult trading, the company said.
Berisford said independent research predicted that the U.S. foodservice market in which Welbilt operates would grow 1.4 percent in real terms in 1997.
